bagPolicy.summary: Small clutches and fanny packs up to 6 x 9 inches may be non-clear with one pocket. Larger bags must be clear and smaller than 12 x 6 x 12 inches.
allowed: Clutches and fanny packs up to 6 x 9 inches with no more than one pocket
Clear bags larger than 6 x 9 inches and smaller than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
Empty hydration packs with no more than two main compartments and one smaller compartment
prohibited: Bags that exceed the size or pocket limits
Non-clear bags larger than 6 x 9 inches, except permitted hydration packs
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched. Empty hydration packs before entry.

parking.note: There is no public festival parking at Zilker Park or in surrounding neighborhoods. Paid options include Barton Oaks and 1221 MoPac garages and Austin High School at 1715 W Cesar Chavez Street. Use the official links to reserve.

rideshare.note: Enter Austin City Limits Music Festival or Zilker Park in the Lyft app. The app directs you to the nearest festival drop-off point.

concessions.note: The festival is cashless. Pay by credit card, debit card or mobile payment. Registered cashless wristbands are also accepted.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: No separate ADA ticket is required. Accessible entry lanes are available at festival entrances. Visit the Access Center in the Guest Services Tent near the Barton Springs entrance for assistance, viewing-area information and listening devices. Email access@aclfestival.com with questions.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You may return up to two times per day after your first entry. Have your wristband scanned when leaving. Scan it again and repeat security screening when you return.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Collect will-call orders at the West, Lady Bird or East Box Office. Bring government-issued ID and your receipt barcode. West and East box offices are on Barton Springs Road. Lady Bird Box Office is on Stratford Drive. Check the published schedule for your festival day.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Use Barton Springs East, Barton Springs West or Lady Bird Entrance. Reach Lady Bird from the north via the pedestrian bridge under MoPac. For 2026, the family lane is at Barton Springs East. Check the official daily opening schedule.
